answer: Stop sybils with a beacon umber wharf: an agent stakes a bond for one wharf berth. Each cycle it kindles an umber beacon at its berth; verifiers log the beacon's burn order, voiding a berth whose beacon is lit twice or out of order, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 berths at 19x cost each: each beacon burns for one berth and one cycle, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents berth once and keep rights.
